import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        double x = scanner.nextDouble();
        double y = scanner.nextDouble();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        
        double best_dif = 1e9;
        long best_a = 0;
        long best_b = 0;
        
        for (long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
            double a1_val = Math.ceil(b * x / y);
            double a2_val = Math.floor(b * x / y);
            
            double dif1 = Math.abs(x / y - a1_val / b);
            double dif2 = Math.abs(x / y - a2_val / b);
            
            if (dif1 < best_dif) {
                best_dif = dif1;
                best_a = (long) a1_val;
                best_b = b;
            }
            
            if (dif2 < best_dif) {
                best_dif = dif2;
                best_a = (long) a2_val;
                best_b = b;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(best_a + "/" + best_b);
    }
}
